request.system: You are a strict claim verifier. You only trust the catalog facts given to you.
request.user:
Verify every factual claim in the campaign is grounded in the catalog facts. Fail if any claim is unsupported, exaggerated, or contradicts the facts.
Rules (from reviewer overrides):
- ANY mention of an out-of-stock product (stock 0) fails, whether or not the copy prompts purchase — no editorial exception.
- Numeric spec claims (lumens, hours, capacity, ratings) must match the catalog exactly; doubling or inflating a spec fails.
- Transferring an attribute from another product, or upgrading 'water-resistant' to 'waterproof', is a fabricated claim and fails.
- A comparative or superlative claim ('brightest', 'longest-lasting', 'most X') is scoped to the product type named in the claim and checked against the comparison set below: it fails if a same-type peer beats the subject on the compared attribute. Vague puffery ('great gear', 'toughest', 'best ever') with no measurable attribute is acceptable.
Catalog facts:
NB-JKT-07 Northbay Stormline Shell Jacket: attributes={'layers': 3, 'waterproof_rating_mm': 20000, 'breathability_gm2': 20000, 'weight_grams': 420, 'material': '3-layer laminate'} stock=12

Claims to verify:
- 20% off jackets, ends Sunday
- 20,000mm waterproof rating
- 20,000 g/m² breathability
- 3-layer laminate construction
- 420 grams weight
- Waterproof and breathable at 20k/20k
- 3-layer construction for sustained wet weather

Body: You've got a trip coming up. The weather won't cooperate. It never does.

The Northbay Stormline Shell Jacket (NB-JKT-07) is built for exactly that.

• 20,000mm waterproof rating — keeps rain out on sustained wet-weather days
• 20,000 g/m² breathability — moving hard won't leave you soaked from the inside
• 3-layer laminate construction — not a coating that peels, a true bonded shell
• 420 grams — light enough that you'll forget it's in your pack until you need it

This is a shell. It's not insulated. Pair it with what you already know works underneath.

Now through Sunday, take 20% off. One jacket, one deal, one deadline.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose or code fences. Reason first, then decide — the verdict must follow from the reasoning. Use exactly this key order: {"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "evidence": ["<short quote or fact>", ...], "score": <float 0-1>, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"}.

response:
```json
{
  "reasoning": "All numeric specifications (20,000mm waterproof rating, 20,000 g/m² breathability, 3-layer laminate, 420 grams) match catalog facts exactly; stock is 12 (not zero); no exaggerated claims, fabrications, or unsupported comparatives; promotional details (20% off, ends Sunday) are editorial claims outside catalog scope; product is in stock and all factual claims are grounded in provided catalog data.",
  "evidence": [
    "waterproof_rating_mm: 20000 matches '20,000mm waterproof rating' claim",
    "breathability_gm2: 20000 matches '20,000 g/m² breathability' claim",
    "material: '3-layer laminate' matches '3-layer laminate construction' claim",
    "weight_grams: 420 matches '420 grams' claim",
    "stock=12 (not zero, product is available)",
    "No comparative/superlative claims made (no 'brightest', 'longest-lasting', etc.)",
    "No attribute transferred from other products",
    "No upgrade of water-resistant to waterproof (already rated waterproof in catalog)"
  ],
  "score": 1.0,
  "verdict": "pass"
}
```
